html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <style>
        /* IATA Air Waybill (MAWB) — Resolution 600a face layout per issued carrier AWB */
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        body { font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 7pt; line-height: 1.12; color: #000; background: white; text-rendering: geometricPrecision; }
        .awb-outer { width: 100%; max-width: 202mm; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0; }
        .mawb-form-head td { padding: 0.35mm 0.55mm; vertical-align: middle; font-weight: 900; font-size: 8pt; }
        .mawb-form-head .awb-prefix { width: 8mm; text-align: center; }
        .mawb-form-head .awb-origin { width: 10mm; text-align: center; }
        .mawb-form-head .awb-serial { text-align: right; }
        .carrier-col { text-align: center; padding: 0.5mm 0.6mm !important; vertical-align: top; }
        .carrier-col .c-logo { margin: 0 auto 0.5mm; }
        .carrier-col .carrier-issued { text-align: right; font-size: 5.5pt; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0.15mm; }
        .nnego { font-size: 5.2pt; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-align: center; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 0.15mm; }
        .ref-mini { font-size: 5pt; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 0.2mm; }
        .insurance-note { font-size: 4.5pt; font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; line-height: 1.08; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0.2mm; }
        .f-foot-wrap { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 5pt; font-weight: 900; padding: 0.25mm 0.5mm; background: #d2d2d2; border: 1px solid #000; border-top: 0; }
        .f-foot-wrap .f-foot-center { flex: 1; text-align: center; }
        .f-foot-wrap .f-foot-right { text-align: right; min-width: 18mm; }
        .mawb-wc3 { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
        .mawb-wc3 td { border: 1px solid #000; width: 33.33%; vertical-align: top; padding: 0; }
        .awb-form { border: 2px solid #000; background: #fff; }
        .g { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; border: none; }
        .g td, .g th { border: 1px solid #000; vertical-align: top; padding: 0.4mm 0.55mm; }
        .cell-r { position: relative; }
        .fnum { position: absolute; left: 0.45mm; top: 0.25mm; font-size: 6.5pt; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; }
        .iata-lbl { display: block; font-size: 6pt; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.08; margin-bottom: 0.25mm; padding-top: 2mm; }
        .iata-txt { font-size: 7.5pt; line-height: 1.12; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; word-wrap: break-word; }
        .iata-txt-sm { font-size: 5.5pt; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; }
        .iata-txt b { font-weight: 800; }
        .th-diag { position: relative; height: 7mm; padding: 0 !important; vertical-align: middle !important; }
        .th-diag-inner { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 7mm; }
        .th-diag-inner::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom left, transparent 48.5%, #000 49%, #000 51%, transparent 51.5%); pointer-events: none; }
        .th-diag .d-tl { position: absolute; left: 0.35mm; bottom: 0.25mm; font-size: 4.6pt; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; z-index: 1; }
        .th-diag .d-br { position: absolute; right: 0.35mm; top: 0.25mm; font-size: 4.6pt; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; z-index: 1; }
        .awb-mono { font-family: "Courier New", Courier, "Liberation Mono", monospace; }
        .issued-by-lbl { font-size: 5pt; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 0.2mm; text-align: left; }
        .nnego .awb-title { font-size: 7pt; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
        .copies-note { font-size: 4.5pt; font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; text-align: justify; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0.25mm 0; }
        .iata-txt-legal { font-size: 4.8pt; font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; line-height: 1.1; text-align: justify; }
        .logo-img { max-width: 36mm; max-height: 14mm; object-fit: contain; display: block; margin: 0.3mm auto 0; }
        .logo-ph { width: 28mm; height: 8mm; background: #ececec; border: 1px solid #999; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 5.5pt; color: #666; margin: 0.3mm auto 0; }
        .mini-h { font-size: 4.6pt; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; }
        .r-cell { text-align: center; font-size: 4pt; }
        .cargo-t { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; border: 1px solid #000; position: relative; }
        .cargo-t th { border: 1px solid #000; padding: 0.25mm; font-size: 5.5pt; font-weight: 800; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; background: #fff; line-height: 1.05; }
        .cargo-t td { border: 1px solid #000; padding: 0.28mm 0.3mm; font-size: 4pt; line-height: 1.1; vertical-align: top; }
        .cargo-t tr.cargo-totals td { font-weight: 800; background: #fafafa; }
        .cargo-t td.n { text-align: right; }
        .cargo-t td.c { text-align: center; }
        .marks { background: #e8e8e8; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; font-size: 3.5pt; }
        .cargo-wrap { position: relative; }
        .paid-stamp {
            position: absolute; left: 8%; right: 8%; top: 42%; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none;
            text-align: center; font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace; font-size: 7pt; font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #000; border: 2px solid #000; padding: 0.5mm 1mm;
            transform: rotate(-8deg); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
        }
        .mawb-bottom { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; border: 1px solid #000; border-top: 0; }
        .mawb-bottom > tbody > tr > td { border: 1px solid #000; vertical-align: top; padding: 0; }
        .mawb-bl { width: 33%; }
        .mawb-br { width: 67%; }
        .mawb-lc { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; }
        .mawb-lc td { border: 1px solid #000; vertical-align: top; padding: 0; }
        .mawb-tab {
            font-size: 4.5pt; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
            background: #dedede; padding: 0.4mm 0.6mm; line-height: 1.05; border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
        }
        .mawb-pc-h { font-size: 3.8pt; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; padding: 0.2mm 0; line-height: 1; }
        .mawb-amt { min-height: 5.5mm; font-size: 3.5pt; }
        .mawb-amt .mawb-pc-h { border-bottom: 1px solid #bbb; }
        .mawb-amt-val { font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace; font-size: 4pt; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; padding: 0.35mm 0.2mm; min-height: 3.5mm; }
        .mawb-shade { background: #c8c8c8; min-height: 4mm; border: 1px solid #000; }
        .mawb-oc-title { font-size: 4.5pt; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; background: #dedede; border: 1px solid #000; border-bottom: none; padding: 0.35mm; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
        .mawb-oc-lines { border: 1px solid #000; border-top: 0; padding: 0.45mm 0.55mm; min-height: 14mm; font-size: 3.5pt; line-height: 1.25; }
        .oc-line { font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace; font-size: 3.5pt; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
        .mawb-cert-r { border: 1px solid #000; border-top: 0; padding: 0.45mm 0.55mm; font-size: 3.5pt; line-height: 1.12; text-align: justify; }
        .mawb-cert-r b { font-weight: 800; }
        .mawb-sign-name { padding: 0.35mm 0.55mm 0; font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace; font-size: 4.5pt; font-weight: 700; }
        .mawb-dotted { border: none; border-bottom: 1px dotted #000; min-height: 4mm; margin: 0 0.55mm; }
        .mawb-slbl { font-size: 4.6pt; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; padding: 0.15mm 0.55mm 0.35mm; }
        .mawb-exec { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border-top: 1px solid #000; }
        .mawb-exec td { border: 1px solid #000; vertical-align: top; padding: 0.35mm 0.45mm; width: 33.33%; }
        .mawb-exec-mono { font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace; font-size: 4.5pt; font-weight: 700; min-height: 4mm; }
        .mawb-exec-corner { position: relative; text-align: right; vertical-align: bottom !important; }
        .mawb-exec-num { font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace; font-size: 8.5pt; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 0.2mm 0; }
        .f-foot { text-align: center; font-size: 5pt; font-weight: 900; padding: 0.25mm; background: #d2d2d2; border: 1px solid #000; border-top: 0; }
        .meta-foot { font-size: 5.5pt; margin-top: 0.2mm; padding: 0.1mm 0; border-top: 1px solid #ccc; }
        @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 4.5mm 5mm; }
        @media print {
            body { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
            .g tr { page-break-inside: avoid; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
{% set default_company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company") or frappe.db.get_default("company") %}
{% set _linked_shipments = frappe.get_all("Air Shipment", filters={"master_awb": doc.name}, fields=["name", "company"], order_by="name asc", limit_page_length=100) %}
{% set linked_company = _linked_shipments[0].company if _linked_shipments and _linked_shipments[0].company else None %}
{% set company_doc = None %}
{% if linked_company and frappe.db.exists("Company", linked_company) %}
{% set company_doc = frappe.get_doc("Company", linked_company) %}
{% elif default_company and frappe.db.exists("Company", default_company) %}
{% set company_doc = frappe.get_doc("Company", default_company) %}
{% endif %}
{% set ps = None %}
{% if _linked_shipments %}
{% set ps = frappe.get_doc("Air Shipment", _linked_shipments[0].name) %}
{% endif %}
{% set curr = company_doc.default_currency if company_doc and company_doc.default_currency else (frappe.db.get_default("currency") or "") %}
{% set mawb_raw = doc.master_awb_no or doc.name %}
{% set iata_cass = "" %}
{% if frappe.db.exists("IATA Settings", "IATA Settings") %}
{% set iata_cass = frappe.db.get_value("IATA Settings", "IATA Settings", "cass_participant_code") or "" %}
{% endif %}
{% set airline_doc = None %}
{% set airline_iata = "" %}
{% set airline_name = "" %}
{% set airline_city = "" %}
{% set airline_country = "" %}
{% if doc.airline and frappe.db.exists("Airline", doc.airline) %}
{% set airline_doc = frappe.get_doc("Airline", doc.airline) %}
{% set airline_iata = airline_doc.iata_code or "" %}
{% set airline_name = airline_doc.airline_name or doc.airline %}
{% set airline_city = (airline_doc.city or "")|upper %}
{% set airline_country = (airline_doc.country or "")|upper %}
{% endif %}
{% set legs = ps.routing_legs if ps else [] %}
{% set leg1 = legs[0] if legs|length > 0 else None %}
{% set leg2 = legs[1] if legs|length > 1 else None %}
{% set leg3 = legs[2] if legs|length > 2 else None %}
{% if ps and ps.airline and not airline_iata %}{% set airline_iata = frappe.db.get_value("Airline", ps.airline, "iata_code") or "" %}{% endif %}
{% macro awb_11(n) -%}
{%- if n -%}
{%- set d = (n|string)|replace(" ", "")|replace("-", "") -%}
{%- if d|length == 11 -%}{{ d[0:3] }}-{{ d[3:11] }}{%- else -%}{{ n }}{%- endif -%}
{%- else -%}—{%- endif -%}
{%- endmacro %}
{% macro awb_prefix(n) -%}
{%- if n -%}{%- set d = (n|string)|replace(" ", "")|replace("-", "") -%}{%- if d|length >= 3 -%}{{ d[0:3] }}{%- else -%}{{ airline_iata or d }}{%- endif -%}{%- elif airline_iata -%}{{ airline_iata }}{%- endif -%}
{%- endmacro %}
{% macro awb_serial(n) -%}
{%- if n -%}{%- set d = (n|string)|replace(" ", "")|replace("-", "") -%}{%- if d|length >= 11 -%}{{ d[3:11] }}{%- else -%}{{ d }}{%- endif -%}{%- endif -%}
{%- endmacro %}
{% macro unloco_label(code) -%}
    {%- if code -%}
        {%- set u = frappe.db.get_value("UNLOCO", code, ["unlocode", "location_name"], as_dict=True) -%}
        {%- if u -%}{{ u.unlocode or code }}{% if u.location_name %} — {{ u.location_name }}{% endif %}{%- else -%}{{ code }}{%- endif -%}
    {%- endif -%}
{%- endmacro %}
{% macro airport_code(code) -%}
    {%- if code -%}{{ frappe.db.get_value("UNLOCO", code, "unlocode") or code }}{%- endif -%}
{%- endmacro %}
{% macro port_city_upper(code) -%}
{%- if code -%}
{%- set u = frappe.db.get_value("UNLOCO", code, ["location_name", "unlocode"], as_dict=True) -%}
{{ ((u.location_name or u.unlocode or "")|upper) if u else "" }}
{%- endif -%}
{%- endmacro %}
{% macro leg_carrier_name(leg) -%}
{%- if leg and leg.airline -%}{{ frappe.db.get_value("Airline", leg.airline, "airline_name") or frappe.db.get_value("Airline", leg.airline, "iata_code") or "" }}{%- elif airline_name -%}{{ airline_name }}{%- endif -%}
{%- endmacro %}
{% macro leg_iata(leg) -%}
{%- if leg and leg.airline -%}{{ frappe.db.get_value("Airline", leg.airline, "iata_code") or "" }}{%- elif airline_iata -%}{{ airline_iata }}{%- endif -%}
{%- endmacro %}
{% macro flight_date_short(leg, dt) -%}
{%- if leg -%}
{%- set ai = frappe.db.get_value("Airline", leg.airline, "iata_code") or airline_iata if leg.airline else airline_iata -%}
{%- set fi = ((ai ~ (leg.flight_no or ""))|replace(" ", "")) -%}
{%- if dt -%}{{ fi }}/{{ frappe.utils.getdate(dt).day }}{%- elif doc.flight_date -%}{{ fi }}/{{ frappe.utils.getdate(doc.flight_date).day }}{%- else -%}{{ fi }}{%- endif -%}
{%- elif doc.flight_no -%}
{%- set fi = ((airline_iata ~ (doc.flight_no or ""))|replace(" ", "")) -%}
{%- if doc.flight_date -%}{{ fi }}/{{ frappe.utils.getdate(doc.flight_date).day }}{%- else -%}{{ fi }}{%- endif -%}
{%- endif -%}
{%- endmacro %}
{% macro fmt_amt(v) -%}{%- if v is not none and v != '' -%}{{ "%.2f"|format(v|flt) }}{%- endif -%}{%- endmacro %}
{% set inc = ((ps.incoterm if ps else "") or "")|string|upper|replace(" ", "")|trim %}
{% if inc in ['CIF', 'CIP', 'CFR', 'CPT', 'DAP', 'DPU', 'DDP', 'DDU'] %}
  {% set chgs = 'PP' %}
  {% set freight_prepaid = true %}
  {% set freight_banner = 'FREIGHT PREPAID' %}
{% elif inc in ['FOB', 'FAS', 'FCA', 'EXW'] %}
  {% set chgs = 'CC' %}
  {% set freight_prepaid = false %}
  {% set freight_banner = 'FREIGHT COLLECT' %}
{% else %}
  {% set chgs = 'PP' %}
  {% set freight_prepaid = true %}
  {% set freight_banner = 'FREIGHT AS ARRANGED' %}
{% endif %}
{% set origin_code = doc.origin_airport or (ps.origin_port if ps else None) %}
{% set dest_code = doc.destination_airport or (ps.destination_port if ps else None) %}
{% set origin_iata_disp = doc.origin_airport_iata or airport_code(origin_code) %}
{% set origin_short = port_city_upper(origin_code) %}
{% set dest_short = port_city_upper(dest_code) %}
{% set ca = None %}
{% if company_doc and company_doc.address and frappe.db.exists("Address", company_doc.address) %}
{% set ca = frappe.get_doc("Address", company_doc.address) %}
{% endif %}
{% set agent_name = "" %}
{% if doc.sending_agent and frappe.db.exists("Freight Agent", doc.sending_agent) %}
{% set agent_name = frappe.db.get_value("Freight Agent", doc.sending_agent, "freight_agent_name") or doc.sending_agent %}
{% elif ps and ps.freight_agent %}
{% set agent_name = ps.freight_agent %}
{% elif company_doc %}
{% set agent_name = company_doc.company_name %}
{% endif %}
{% set shipper_code = frappe.db.get_value("Shipper", ps.shipper, "code") if ps and ps.shipper else "" %}
{% set consignee_code = frappe.db.get_value("Consignee", ps.consignee, "code") if ps and ps.consignee else "" %}
{% set pkg0 = ps.packages[0] if ps and ps.packages and (ps.packages|length > 0) else None %}
{% set hs_display = "" %}
{% if pkg0 and pkg0.hs_code %}
{% set hs_display = frappe.db.get_value("Customs Tariff Number", pkg0.hs_code, "tariff_number") or pkg0.hs_code %}
{% endif %}
{% set commodity_item_display = "" %}
{% if pkg0 and pkg0.commodity %}
{% set commodity_item_display = frappe.db.get_value("Commodity", pkg0.commodity, "iata_commodity_code") or frappe.db.get_value("Commodity", pkg0.commodity, "code") or "" %}
{% endif %}
{% set rate_class = "" %}
{% if ps and ps.load_type %}{% set rate_class = (ps.load_type|string)[0:1]|upper %}{% endif %}
{# Aggregate cargo + charges from linked shipments #}
{% set agg = namespace(packs=0, total_weight=doc.booked_weight_kg|flt if doc.booked_weight_kg is not none else 0, chargeable=0, desc_parts=[], weight_amt=0, weight_rate=0, other_carrier_amt=0, other_lines=[]) %}
{% for row in _linked_shipments %}
{% set ss = frappe.get_doc("Air Shipment", row.name) %}
{% if ss.packs is not none %}{% set agg.packs = agg.packs + (ss.packs|flt) %}{% endif %}
{% if ss.total_weight is not none and not doc.booked_weight_kg %}{% set agg.total_weight = agg.total_weight + (ss.total_weight|flt) %}{% endif %}
{% if ss.chargeable is not none %}{% set agg.chargeable = agg.chargeable + (ss.chargeable|flt) %}{% endif %}
{% if ss.description %}{% set _ = agg.desc_parts.append(ss.description) %}{% endif %}
{% for c in ss.charges or [] %}
{% if c.charge_type != 'Cost' %}
{% set lbl = ((c.item_name or c.item_code or '')|upper)|trim %}
{% set amt = (c.actual_revenue or c.estimated_revenue or c.base_amount or 0)|flt %}
{% set rate = (c.unit_rate or 0)|flt %}
{% if 'FREIGHT' in lbl or 'AIR' in lbl or (c.service_type == 'Air' and not agg.weight_amt) %}
{% if amt > 0 or rate > 0 %}
{% if amt > agg.weight_amt %}{% set agg.weight_amt = amt %}{% endif %}
{% if rate > 0 %}{% set agg.weight_rate = rate %}{% elif agg.chargeable and amt %}{% set agg.weight_rate = (amt / agg.chargeable)|round(2) %}{% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% elif amt > 0 %}
{% set agg.other_carrier_amt = agg.other_carrier_amt + amt %}
{% set code = (c.item_code or (lbl|replace(' ', ''))[:3])|upper %}
{% set _ = agg.other_lines.append(code ~ ' ' ~ fmt_amt(amt)) %}
{% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
{% endfor %}
{% if not agg.packs and ps and ps.packs is not none %}{% set agg.packs = ps.packs|flt %}{% endif %}
{% if not agg.total_weight and ps and ps.total_weight is not none %}{% set agg.total_weight = ps.total_weight|flt %}{% endif %}
{% if not agg.chargeable and ps and ps.chargeable is not none %}{% set agg.chargeable = ps.chargeable|flt %}{% endif %}
{% if not agg.weight_rate and agg.weight_amt and agg.chargeable %}{% set agg.weight_rate = (agg.weight_amt / agg.chargeable)|round(2) %}{% endif %}
{% set total_prepaid = (agg.weight_amt + agg.other_carrier_amt) if freight_prepaid else 0 %}
{% set carrier_signer = '' %}
{% if doc.modified_by %}{% set carrier_signer = (frappe.db.get_value('User', doc.modified_by, 'full_name') or doc.modified_by)|upper %}{% elif doc.owner %}{% set carrier_signer = (frappe.db.get_value('User', doc.owner, 'full_name') or doc.owner)|upper %}{% endif %}
{% set exec_date_str = '' %}
{% set exec_dt = doc.flight_date or (ps.booking_date if ps else None) %}
{% if exec_dt %}
{% set _bd = frappe.utils.getdate(exec_dt) %}
{% set exec_date_str = _bd.strftime('%d%b%Y').upper() %}
{% endif %}
{% set exec_place_str = origin_short %}
{% if origin_iata_disp and exec_place_str and origin_iata_disp not in exec_place_str %}
{% set exec_place_str = exec_place_str.split('(')[0]|trim %}
{% endif %}
{% set handling_text = '' %}
{% if ps %}
{% if ps.additional_terms %}{% set handling_text = ps.additional_terms|replace('\n', ' ') %}{% else %}PLEASE NOTIFY CONSIGNEE UPON ARRIVAL. DOCUMENTS AS PER MANIFEST.{% endif %}
{% if ps.contains_dangerous_goods %}{% set handling_text = handling_text ~ ' — DANGEROUS GOODS AS PER IATA DGR.' %}{% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% set sci_code = '' %}
{% if ps and ps.entry_type %}
{% set sci_code = (ps.entry_type|string)[0:1]|upper ~ ('1' if 'Transit' in (ps.entry_type|string) else '') %}
{% if ps.entry_type == 'Transit' %}{% set sci_code = 'T1' %}{% elif ps.entry_type == 'Transshipment' %}{% set sci_code = 'T2' %}{% elif ps.entry_type == 'Direct' %}{% set sci_code = 'T1' %}{% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% set notify_contact = '' %}
{% if ps and ps.consignee_contact_display %}
{% set notify_contact = ps.consignee_contact_display|replace('\n', ' ') %}
{% endif %}
<div class="awb-outer">
        <div class="awb-form">
            <table class="g mawb-form-head">
                <tr>
                    <td class="awb-prefix awb-mono" style="width:8mm;">{{ awb_prefix(mawb_raw) }}</td>
                    <td class="awb-origin awb-mono" style="width:10mm;">{{ origin_iata_disp or '' }}</td>
                    <td style="border-left:none;border-right:none;"> </td>
                    <td class="awb-serial awb-mono">{{ awb_prefix(mawb_raw) }}-{{ awb_serial(mawb_raw) }}</td>
                </tr>
            </table>
            <table class="g">
                <colgroup>
                    <col style="width: 45%;">
                    <col style="width: 15%;">
                    <col style="width: 40%;">
                </colgroup>
                <tr>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="min-height: 26mm;">
                        <span class="fnum">1</span>
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Shipper's Name and Address</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt" style="text-align: left;">
                            {% if ps %}
                            {% if ps.shipper %}{{ ps.shipper }}<br>{% endif %}
{% if ps.shipper_address_display %}{{ ps.shipper_address_display|replace('\n', '<br>')|safe }}{% endif %}
{% if ps.shipper_contact_display %}<br>{{ ps.shipper_contact_display|replace('\n', '<br>')|safe }}{% endif %}
{% if _linked_shipments|length > 1 %}<br><span style="font-size:5pt;">+ {{ _linked_shipments|length - 1 }} more shipment(s)</span>{% endif %}
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="min-height: 26mm;">

                    </td>
                    <td class="carrier-col cell-r" rowspan="2" style="vertical-align: top;">
                        <div class="nnego">Not Negotiable <span class="awb-title">AIR WAYBILL</span></div>

                        <img src="{{ airline_doc.logo }}" alt="" class="logo-img c-logo" />
                        {% endif %}
                        <div class="copies-note">Copies 1, 2 and 3 of this Air Waybill are originals and have the same validity.</div>
                        <div class="iata-txt-legal">
                            It is agreed that the goods described herein are accepted in apparent good order and condition (except as noted) for carriage SUBJECT TO THE CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT ON THE REVERSE HEREOF. ALL GOODS MAY BE CARRIED BY ANY OTHER MEANS INCLUDING ROAD OR ANY OTHER CARRIER UNLESS SPECIFIC CONTRARY INSTRUCTIONS ARE GIVEN HEREON BY THE SHIPPER, AND SHIPPER AGREES THAT THE SHIPMENT MAY BE CARRIED VIA INTERMEDIATE STOPPING PLACES WHICH THE CARRIER DEEMS APPROPRIATE. THE SHIPPER'S ATTENTION IS DRAWN TO THE NOTICE CONCERNING CARRIER'S LIMITATION OF LIABILITY.
                        </div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="min-height: 22mm; max-height: 34mm; overflow: hidden;">
                        <span class="fnum">2</span>
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Consignee's Name and Address</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt" style="text-align: left;">
                            {% if ps %}
                            {% if ps.consignee %}{{ ps.consignee }}<br>{% endif %}
{% if ps.consignee_address_display %}{{ ps.consignee_address_display|replace('\n', '<br>')|safe }}{% endif %}
{% if ps.consignee_contact_display %}<br>{{ ps.consignee_contact_display|replace('\n', '<br>')|safe }}{% endif %}
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r">
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Consignee's Account Number</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt">{{ consignee_code or '' }}</div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td class="cell-r" colspan="2" style="min-height: 12mm;">
                        <span class="fnum">3</span>
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Issuing Carrier's Agent Name and City</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt" style="text-align: left;">
                            {% if agent_name %}{{ agent_name|upper }}<br>{% endif %}
{% if ca %}
{% if ca.address_line1 %}{{ ca.address_line1|upper }}{% endif %}{% if ca.address_line2 %} {{ ca.address_line2|upper }}{% endif %}
{% if ca.city %}<br>{{ ca.city|upper }}{% if ca.state %}, {{ ca.state|upper }}{% endif %}{% if ca.pincode %} {{ ca.pincode }}{% endif %}{% if ca.country %} {{ ca.country|upper }}{% endif %}{% endif %}
{% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="vertical-align: top;">
                        <span class="fnum">4</span>
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Accounting Information</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt-sm" style="text-align:left;">{{ freight_banner|upper }}</div>
                        <div class="ref-mini">Agent's Ref: <span class="awb-mono">{{ doc.agent_reference or doc.booking_reference_no or '' }}</span></div>
                        <div class="ref-mini">Shipper's Ref: <span class="awb-mono">{{ (ps.booking_reference if ps else '') or (ps.agent_reference if ps else '') or shipper_code or '' }}</span></div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 30%;">
                        <span class="iata-lbl" style="padding-top: 0;">Agent's IATA Code</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt awb-mono" style="font-size: 6.5pt;">{{ iata_cass or '' }}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 30%;">
                        <span class="iata-lbl" style="padding-top: 0;">Account No.</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt awb-mono" style="font-size: 6.5pt;">{{ doc.agent_reference or (ps.booking_reference if ps else '') or '' }}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 40%;"> </td>
                </tr>
            </table>

            <table class="g">
                <tr>

                        <span class="iata-lbl">Airport of Departure (Addr. of First Carrier) and Requested Routing</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt">{{ origin_short or unloco_label(origin_code) }}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 22%;">
                        <span class="fnum">6</span>
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Reference Number</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt awb-mono">{{ doc.booking_reference_no or doc.agent_reference or doc.name }}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 42%;">
                        <span class="fnum">7</span>
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Optional Shipping Information</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt-sm">{% if doc.sending_agent or doc.receiving_agent %}{{ doc.sending_agent or '—' }} / {{ doc.receiving_agent or '—' }}{% endif %}</div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>

            <table class="g">
                <tr>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 5%;"><span class="mini-h">to</span><br><span class="iata-txt-sm">{% if leg1 %}{{ airport_code(leg1.discharge_port) }}{% elif dest_code %}{{ airport_code(dest_code) }}{% endif %}</span></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 6%;"><span class="mini-h">By First<br>Carrier</span><br><span class="iata-txt-sm">{% if leg1 %}{{ leg_carrier_name(leg1)|upper }}{% elif airline_name %}{{ airline_name|upper }}{% endif %}</span></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 5%;"><span class="mini-h">to</span><br><span class="iata-txt-sm">{% if leg2 %}{{ airport_code(leg2.discharge_port) }}{% endif %}</span></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 5%;"><span class="mini-h">by</span><br><span class="iata-txt-sm">{% if leg2 %}{{ leg_iata(leg2) }}{% endif %}</span></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 5%;"><span class="mini-h">to</span><br><span class="iata-txt-sm">{% if leg3 %}{{ airport_code(leg3.discharge_port) }}{% endif %}</span></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 5%;"><span class="mini-h">by</span><br><span class="iata-txt-sm">{% if leg3 %}{{ leg_iata(leg3) }}{% endif %}</span></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 5%;"><span class="fnum">12</span><span class="iata-lbl" style="padding-top:1.8mm; text-align:center;">Currency</span><div class="iata-txt-sm">{{ curr or '' }}</div></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 5%;"><span class="fnum">13</span><span class="iata-lbl" style="padding-top:1.8mm; text-align:center;">CHGS<br>Code</span><div class="iata-txt-sm">{{ chgs }}</div></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 4%;"><span class="fnum">14</span><span class="mini-h" style="display:block;padding-top:1.5mm;">W/Val<br>PPD</span><div class="iata-txt-sm">{{ 'X' if freight_prepaid else '—' }}</div></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 4%;"><span class="mini-h" style="display:block;padding-top:1.5mm;">COL</span><div class="iata-txt-sm">{{ 'X' if not freight_prepaid else '—' }}</div></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 4%;"><span class="fnum">15</span><span class="mini-h" style="display:block;padding-top:1.5mm;">Other<br>PPD</span><div class="iata-txt-sm">{{ 'X' if freight_prepaid else '—' }}</div></td>
                    <td class="r-cell cell-r" style="width: 4%;"><span class="mini-h" style="display:block;padding-top:1.5mm;">COL</span><div class="iata-txt-sm">{{ 'X' if not freight_prepaid else '—' }}</div></td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 13%;"><span class="fnum">16</span><span class="iata-lbl">Declared Value for Carriage</span><div class="iata-txt">{% if ps and ps.insurance is not none and (ps.insurance|float(0) > 0) %}AS DECLARED{% else %}N.V.D.{% endif %}</div></td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 13%;"><span class="fnum">17</span><span class="iata-lbl">Declared Value for Customs</span><div class="iata-txt">{% if ps and ps.goods_value is not none and (ps.goods_value|float(0) > 0) %}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(ps.goods_value, currency=curr) if curr else frappe.utils.fmt_money(ps.goods_value) }}{% else %}N.C.V.{% endif %}</div></td>
                </tr>
            </table>

            <table class="g">
                <tr>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 34%;">
                        <span class="fnum">8</span>
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Airport of Departure</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt">{{ origin_short or unloco_label(origin_code) }}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 33%;">
                        <span class="fnum">8A</span>
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Requested Flight/Date</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt awb-mono">{% if leg1 %}{{ flight_date_short(leg1, ps.etd if ps else None) }}{% else %}{{ flight_date_short(None, None) }}{% endif %}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 33%;">
                        <span class="fnum">9</span>
                        <span class="iata-lbl">Amount of Insurance</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt">{% if ps and ps.insurance is not none and (ps.insurance|float(0) > 0) %}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(ps.insurance, currency=curr) if curr else frappe.utils.fmt_money(ps.insurance) }}{% else %}XXX{% endif %}</div>
                        <div class="insurance-note">INSURANCE — IF CARRIER OFFERS INSURANCE, AND SUCH INSURANCE IS REQUESTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CONDITIONS THEREOF, INDICATE AMOUNT TO BE INSURED IN FIGURES IN BOX MARKED "AMOUNT OF INSURANCE".</div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>

            <table class="g">
                <tr>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 34%;">
                        <span class="iata-lbl" style="padding-top:0;">Airport of Destination</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt">{{ dest_short or unloco_label(dest_code) }}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 33%;">
                        <span class="iata-lbl" style="padding-top:0;">Flight/Date</span>
                        <div class="iata-txt awb-mono">{{ flight_date_short(leg2, ps.eta if ps else None) }}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="cell-r" style="width: 33%;">
                        <span class="fnum">21</span>

{% if notify_contact %}<br>{{ notify_contact|upper }}{% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>

            <div class="cargo-wrap">
            {% if freight_prepaid and agg.weight_amt %}
            <div class="paid-stamp">PAID CARGO {{ airline_iata }} {{ doc.flight_no or '' }}{% if exec_date_str %} {{ (exec_date_str|truncate(5, True, '')) }}{% endif %}</div>
            {% endif %}
            <table class="cargo-t">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th style="width:5%;">No. Of<br>Pieces<br>RCP</th>

                        <th style="width:4%;">kg / lb</th>

                        <th style="width:7%;">Chargeable<br>Weight</th>

                <tbody>
                    <tr>
                        <td class="c iata-txt-sm">{% if agg.packs %}{{ agg.packs|int }}{% endif %}</td>

                        <td class="c iata-txt-sm">{{ rate_class }}{% if commodity_item_display %} / {{ commodity_item_display }}{% endif %}</td>
                        <td class="n iata-txt-sm">{% if agg.chargeable %}{{ "%.0f"|format(agg.chargeable) }}{% endif %}</td>
                        <td class="n iata-txt-sm">{% if agg.weight_rate %}{{ fmt_amt(agg.weight_rate) }}{% endif %}</td>
                        <td class="n iata-txt-sm">{% if agg.weight_amt %}{{ fmt_amt(agg.weight_amt) }}{% elif not agg.weight_rate %}As Agreed{% endif %}</td>
                        <td class="iata-txt-sm" style="text-align:left; font-weight:700;">
                            {% if agg.desc_parts %}{{ (agg.desc_parts|join('; '))|upper }}{% elif ps and ps.description %}{{ ps.description|upper }}{% endif %}
{% if ps and ps.packages and ps.packages|length > 0 %}
                            {% for p in ps.packages %}{% if p.length or p.width or p.height %}
                            {% set _np = (p.no_of_packs|int) if p.no_of_packs is not none else 1 %}
                            {% set _du = ((frappe.db.get_value('UOM', p.dimension_uom, 'uom_name') or 'CM')|upper) %}
                            <br>{{ _np }} @ {{ (p.length|int) if p.length else '—' }}x{{ (p.width|int) if p.width else '—' }}x{{ (p.height|int) if p.height else '—' }} {{ _du }}
                            {% endif %}{% endfor %}
                            {% endif %}
{% if hs_display %}<br>HS{{ hs_display|string|replace('.', '')|upper }}{% endif %}
{% if ps and ps.total_volume is not none %}
                            <br><span style="font-size:3pt;">VOL.: {{ "%.2f"|format(ps.total_volume) }}{% if ps.total_volume_uom %} {{ frappe.db.get_value("UOM", ps.total_volume_uom, "uom_name") or ps.total_volume_uom }}{% endif %}</span>
                            {% endif %}
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr class="cargo-totals">
                        <td class="c iata-txt-sm">{% if agg.packs %}{{ agg.packs|int }}{% endif %}</td>
                        <td class="n iata-txt-sm">{% if agg.total_weight %}{{ "%.0f"|format(agg.total_weight) }}{% endif %}</td>
                        <td colspan="4"></td>
                        <td class="n iata-txt-sm">{% if agg.weight_amt %}{{ fmt_amt(agg.weight_amt) }}{% endif %}</td>
                        <td></td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <td colspan="7" class="marks">
                            Shipping marks & numbers — {{ airport_code(dest_code) or '' }}{% if ps and ps.marks_and_nos %}<br>{{ ps.marks_and_nos|replace('\n', '<br>')|safe }}{% endif %}
                        </td>
                        <td></td>
                    </tr>
                </tbody>
            </table>
            </div>

            <table class="mawb-bottom">
                <tr>
                    <td class="mawb-bl">
                        <table class="mawb-lc">
                            <tr><td colspan="2" class="mawb-tab">Weight Charge</td></tr>
                            <tr><td colspan="2" style="padding:0;border:none;">
                                <table class="mawb-wc3">
                                    <tr>
                                        <td><div class="mawb-pc-h">Prepaid</div><div class="mawb-amt-val">{% if freight_prepaid and agg.weight_amt %}{{ fmt_amt(agg.weight_amt) }}{% endif %}</div></td>
                                        <td><div class="mawb-pc-h">Weight Charge</div></td>
                                        <td><div class="mawb-pc-h">Collect</div></td>
                                    </tr>
                                </table>
                            </td></tr>
                            <tr><td colspan="2" class="mawb-tab">Valuation Charge</td></tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Prepaid</div></td>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Collect</div></td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr><td colspan="2" class="mawb-tab">Tax</td></tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Prepaid</div></td>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Collect</div></td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr><td colspan="2" class="mawb-tab">Total Other Charges Due Agent</td></tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Prepaid</div></td>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Collect</div></td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr><td colspan="2" class="mawb-tab">Total Other Charges Due Carrier</td></tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td class="mawb-amt">
                                    <div class="mawb-pc-h">Prepaid</div>
                                    <div class="mawb-amt-val">{% if freight_prepaid and agg.other_carrier_amt %}{{ fmt_amt(agg.other_carrier_amt) }}{% endif %}</div>
                                </td>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Collect</div></td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr><td colspan="2" class="mawb-shade"></td></tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td class="mawb-amt">
                                    <div class="mawb-pc-h">Total Prepaid</div>
                                    <div class="mawb-amt-val">{% if freight_prepaid and total_prepaid %}{{ fmt_amt(total_prepaid) }}{% endif %}</div>
                                </td>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Total Collect</div></td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Currency Conversion Rates</div></td>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">CC. Charges in Dest. Currency</div></td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">For Carrier's use only at Destination</div></td>
                                <td class="mawb-amt"><div class="mawb-pc-h">Charges at Destination</div></td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr><td colspan="2" class="mawb-tab">Total Collect Charges</td></tr>
                            <tr><td colspan="2" class="mawb-amt" style="min-height:6mm;"></td></tr>
                        </table>
                    </td>
                    <td class="mawb-br">
                        <div class="mawb-oc-title">Other Charges</div>
                        <div class="mawb-oc-lines">
                            {% if agg.other_lines %}
                            {% for line in agg.other_lines %}
                            <div class="oc-line">{{ line }}</div>
                            {% endfor %}
                            {% else %}
                            <div class="oc-line" style="color:#666;">—</div>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                        <div class="mawb-cert-r">
                            Shipper certifies that the particulars on the face hereof are correct and that <b>insofar as any part of the consignment contains dangerous goods, such part is properly described by name and is in proper condition for carriage by air according to the applicable Dangerous Goods Regulations.</b>
                        </div>
                        {% if agent_name %}<div class="mawb-sign-name">{{ agent_name|upper }}</div>{% endif %}
<div class="mawb-dotted"></div>
                        <div class="mawb-slbl">Signature of Shipper or his Agent</div>
                        <table class="mawb-exec">
                            <tr>
                                <td>
                                    <div class="mawb-exec-mono">{% if exec_date_str %}{{ exec_date_str }}{% endif %}</div>
                                    <div class="mawb-dotted"></div>
                                    <div class="mawb-slbl">Executed on (date)</div>
                                </td>
                                <td>
                                    <div class="mawb-exec-mono">{% if exec_place_str %}{{ exec_place_str }}{% endif %}</div>
                                    <div class="mawb-dotted"></div>
                                    <div class="mawb-slbl">at (place)</div>
                                </td>
                                <td class="mawb-exec-corner">
                                    {% if carrier_signer %}<div class="mawb-exec-mono" style="text-align:left;">{{ carrier_signer }}</div>{% endif %}
<div class="mawb-dotted"></div>
                                    <div class="mawb-slbl">Signature</div>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        </table>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>

            <div class="f-foot-wrap">
                <span></span>
                <span class="f-foot-center">Original 2 (for Consignee)</span>
                <span class="f-foot-right awb-mono">{{ awb_prefix(mawb_raw) }}-</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="meta-foot">
            {% if doc.amended_from %}Amend.: {{ doc.amended_from }} · {% endif %}Status: {% if doc.docstatus == 0 %}Draft{% elif doc.docstatus == 1 %}Submitted{% elif doc.docstatus == 2 %}Cancelled{% else %}{{ doc.docstatus }}{% endif %}{% if airline_name %} — {{ airline_name }}{% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>
